rationale: Despite the broader market weakening further (SPY dropping from -1.48% to -1.88%), BXDC has exhibited relative strength over the last 25 minutes by pushing above its 5-minute 9-EMA ($15.60) and grinding higher to $15.62 with 0.00% favorable excursion since entry.
